final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Pods scan in boutique showed a single outlier: shippingservice-799cbfbc76-bl72b 1/2 Error with 4 restarts (CrashLoopBackOff), and deployment shippingservice 0/1 AVAILABLE while every other workload is 1/1. Its server container last terminated with Reason=Error ExitCode=2, kubelet event 'BackOff restarting failed container server'. Container logs show '[ShipOrder] received request' followed by 'panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference / [signal SIGSEGV]' in main.(*server).ShipOrder at /src/main.go:153, i.e. the handler dereferenced an unset in.Address. Topology walk places checkoutservice as the ShipOrder caller, and its source code (checkoutservice/main.go shipOrder) literally sets 'address = nil' before building &pb.ShipOrderRequest{Address: address, Items: items}, so the required Address parameter is omitted in the outgoing call. Config surfaces confirm the transport itself is sound (SHIPPING_SERVICE_ADDR=shippingservice:50051, Service selector app=shippingservice, port/targetPort 50051, grpc probes on 50051), and caller-side evidence shows frontend 500s on /cart and /cart/checkout plus emailservice success-rate vanishing because the checkout flow aborts at the shipOrder step. Thus the fault resides in checkoutservice's code (missing required request parameter) and the availability loss is borne by shippingservice.
